data.desc: Scienjoy Holding Corporation ('Scienjoy' or the 'Company', NASDAQ: SJ) is a technology company powered by a dual engine of 'digital entertainment + enterprise AI solutions,' with AI at the core of its business strategy. The Company has a long track record of providing digital entertainment services to global users, building extensive expertise in digital content, multimodal interaction, and business operations. Leveraging its foundational AI technologies and business agent engines, which have been validated through real-world applications, Scienjoy is extending its capabilities to enterprise customers across a range of industries. Through its forward deployed engineer (FDE) model, AI applications, and intelligent solutions, the Company integrates AI into real-world business processes and operational systems, transforming technological capabilities into tangible business value.
